osm_tags.fixme: Because of recent change in administrative system, the name of the town as well as the zonal administration have been changed. So, correct identification or name of this town as to now is "Nagele Borana"
osm_tags.name: Negele
Qubi iresa matacho
osm_tags.note: Man named mata died of a cold and was buried here.

osm_tags.name: Gof Lon elema
osm_tags.note: Named after a man named Elema whose cows (lon) were stolen from this crater (gof) by the Dasenach. Probably sometime in the 1990s

osm_tags.description: Named because of the rocks (bule) and hyenas (worabesa) commonly coming here
osm_tags.name: Bule worabesa

osm_tags.description:
Seasonal Resevoir
Name "Jatama" comes from the Gabra word for 60. At the time this resevoir was dug, workers were being paid 60 shillings.
osm_tags.name: Haro Jatama
Aldere Forole Peace Dam
osm_tags.note: Boundaries and shape of this resevoir are not accurate since they were not charted, and the feature is not yet shown on satellite imagery. This is a placeholder showing the location of the Dam
